scope: Native SkinnedMesh set source-buffer and derived influence-cache identity. Prerequisite to full model/App composition, not completion of those owners.

archive.integrity: Exact lengths and BLAKE3 body hash
archive.native_admission: Prepare rebuilds native meshes, verifies source words and derived values/cache receipts, restores original alias tables and checks exact canonical recapture

SkinnedMesh.vertices: exact accepted words and actual Arc identity
SkinnedMesh.indices: exact order and actual Arc identity
SkinnedMesh.coherent_weights: native rebuild must equal captured flag
SkinnedMesh.max_position_component: native rebuild must equal captured f32 words
SkinnedMesh.groups: actual Arc identity with native-derived receipt

policies: Aggregate unique source vertices/indices, table counts, mesh count, joint and encoded bytes
Distinct native vertex reconstruction jobs bounded before allocation
Distinct vertex/rig/group/index admission combinations bounded before allocation
Repeated identical mesh records reuse completed native owners
Index-only variants use native with_shared_indices; no vertex reduction/normalization
consumer: Actual Fox import writes skin-set file alongside primitive/image/animation records; source directory removed; restored set assigned into prepared primitives; all clips compare exact local poses, palettes and posed geometry at 120 phases. This is an integrated participant scenario, not complete ModelAsset restoration.
regressions: Dense real file with 131073 vertices per source, two independent vertex buffers and two independent influence-cache owners
Shared and independent buffer/cache relationships including vertex-only and index-only sharing
120 native admission phases and 120 small exact posed-geometry phases
128 repeated instances use one native reconstruction budget; different joint-count jobs require additional budget
Malformed cache/derived flags, nonfinite source, bad references, unused records, truncated/corrupt files, rechecksummed hostile count and policy errors leave original unchanged
initial_rejected_check: New test missed glam::Vec3 import; corrected before focused/full qualification; rejected log retained.
limitations: BLAKE3 cache receipts are compared to a fresh native derivation, not trusted as standalone proof
Policies are not physical peak-memory qualification
Full model cross-participant ownership, source-node metadata, clip mapping, LOD and source observations remain open
Worker/watch and atomic native CPU/GPU/App publication remain open
